title: ScienceLabEngineReceipt/v1
description: A receipt proving a backend engine ran (or failed to run) for a run request, carrying the honest exercise level and execution outcome. The receipt is the unit of compute lineage: it binds a run_request_id to an adapter_id and a pack_ref, names the exercise_level (how far the computation was actually taken) and the engine_execution outcome (failed / completed), and records the resource cost and any output objects produced. CRITICAL INVARIANT (schema + python): an import_probe CANNOT yield engine_execution=completed-and-computed semantics — a receipt whose exercise_level=import_probe MUST carry an empty output_object_ids (maxItems 0), because an import probe only checks the object imports/loads and produces no scientific output. This is the probe-is-not-compute honesty rule (see docs/contracts/evidence-model.md): a probe is not actual compute, and a probe receipt cannot claim output objects. The receipt carries the two safety consts (canonical_writes=0, grants_authority=false). Canonical JSON contract: sorted keys, compact separators, UTF-8, no NaN/Infinity, trailing newline.

allOf.$comment: Probe is not compute: exercise_level=import_probe REQUIRES output_object_ids to be empty (maxItems 0). An import probe only checks the object imports/loads; it cannot have produced scientific output objects. Encoding the probe-is-not-compute rule at the schema layer.

receipt_id.description: Content-addressed identity: sha256 over the canonical encoding of the receipt (without this field), prefixed 'sha256:'. Computed by the python receipt builder.

run_request_id.description: The object_id of the run request this engine run satisfies. A run request is the unit a lab issues to ask an engine to compute; the engine receipt binds back to it so a run receipt can tie the two together.

adapter_id.description: The logical adapter identifier (mirrors AdapterSemanticProfile/v1 adapter_id) of the backend that ran. Names which engine produced the receipt.

pack_ref.description: An ArtifactRef/v1 pointing at the versioned, content-addressed adapter pack (the executable bytes this engine run used). Carried inline as a structural object (schema_version const ArtifactRef/v1, media_type, digest, size_bytes, optional path); the digest is authoritative. The full ArtifactRef/v1 field contract is enforced at the python layer (the repo schema convention is inline structural shapes + python defense-in-depth, not cross-schema $ref, so validation works offline).

media_type.description: IANA-style media type of the referenced pack payload (e.g. application/vnd.srlab.adapter-pack+json).

digest.description: Content digest of the pack bytes: sha256 + 64 lowercase hex digits.

size_bytes.description: Non-negative integer byte count of the referenced pack payload.

path.description: Optional portable repo-relative path to the pack bytes. Validated for portability at the python layer; the digest remains authoritative.

engine_execution.description: Whether the engine run reached completion. failed: the engine ran and failed (no scientific output). completed: the engine ran to completion (output objects, if any, are in output_object_ids). NOT a validation outcome — completed only means the engine finished, not that the output was checked.

wall_seconds.description: Wall-clock seconds the engine run consumed (>= 0). An integer at seconds precision; sub-second runs record 0. A probe records its (typically small) probe wall time.

rss_bytes.description: Peak resident set size in bytes the engine run consumed (>= 0).

output_object_ids.description: The object_ids of the scientific output objects the engine run produced. MUST be empty for exercise_level=import_probe (a probe produces no scientific output; encoded by the allOf/if-then above). Populated for a completed runtime_probe / actual_compute run that produced output.

exercise_level.description: How far the computation was actually taken: import_probe (it imports/loads but does not run — produces no output), runtime_probe (it runs to a probe point), actual_compute (it ran the real computation). An import_probe receipt CANNOT pair with engine_execution=completed-and-computed semantics: it must carry an empty output_object_ids.

created_utc.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp at seconds precision (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ). No offset, no fractional seconds.

canonical_writes.description: Safety const: a receipt is immutable once authored. Always 0; a non-zero value is a contract violation.

grants_authority.description: Safety const: a receipt never grants authority on its own. Always false; a true value is a contract violation. A completed engine run is still an admission of compute lineage, not an authorization to act on the output.
